scale.basis: Ø195 bolt circle, Ø170 cavity, 45/34/16 section depths, 60x25 side pattern, Ø75/Ø65 port; a few sizes scaled from views against these

frame: Housing bore axis = Z. Rear face z=0, front (bolt-flange) face z=100. Origin on the bore axis. +Y up toward the top port, X horizontal across the front view.
body: Octagonal prism, apothem 97 on the orthogonal flats and 107.6 on the 45° flats, z 0..100
Ø170 bore through the full depth, leaving walls
Conical web, run 3 mm into the wall: rear frustum r42 at z29.4 to r88 at z46, ring disc r88 at z45.5..55.5, front frustum r88 at z55 to r42 at z70
Top port: Ø75 boss on the Y axis at z=50, y 90..118.5, with 6 R7.5 lobes on r40

features.source: section B-B 50 bore, 60 counterbore front side
Ø65 port bore into the cavity
6X Ø7 UNTIL NEXT on r40 lobes, 60° spacing
4X Ø10 UNTIL NEXT, 60 x 25 pattern, on each upper diagonal flat

guessed: Orthogonal apothem 97, scaled from the front view
Rear web faces z29.4/z46, scaled from section B-B
Web outer radius 88 so it overlaps the wall cleanly
Ribs, small R fillets and the inner Ø27/Ø35 port detail omitted
